data.name: Joram
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew roots 'yad' (hand) and 'ram' (exalted, high), Joram symbolizes a strong, God-given leader. In the Bible, Joram was the name of two kings of Judah and Israel. King Joram of Judah, also known as Joram son of Jehoshaphat, ruled during a time of peace and prosperity. King Joram of Israel, also known as Joram son of Ahab, was a wicked king who led his people into rebellion against God.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents God's divine guidance and strength.
